facts.title: loss of containment at G-8103 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on G-8103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on G-8103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. G-8103 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during shift handover while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 30 August 2015 an incident occurred on G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
